<!-- For people opening pull requests by hand. Volunteer Pool fills this in for volunteers' AIs. -->

### Goal
<!-- The task id from volunteer-compute.yaml, or the issue, and the outcome in one sentence. -->

### Plan
<!-- What you changed and why this approach. What you left out on purpose. -->

### Evidence
<!-- For each acceptance criterion: how you know it's met. Test output, screenshots. -->

### If it goes wrong
<!-- Is reverting this pull request enough? Anything to watch after merging? -->

### Review checklist
- [ ] Intent: it does what the goal says, and nothing else.
- [ ] Scope: only the expected files changed.
- [ ] Evidence: checks pass, and each acceptance criterion is really met.
- [ ] Ownership: someone on the team understands this change.
- [ ] Policy: no secrets, new dependencies or network calls that weren't asked for.
- [ ] Fallback: reverting is enough if it goes wrong.
